newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: SCHIPHOL AIRPORT SEES JUNE AND MAY CARGO INCREASE.
newsitem.headline: SCHIPHOL AIRPORT SEES JUNE AND MAY CARGO INCREASE.

text.p: Cargo traffic at Amsterdam'S Schiphol Airport rose 9.6 percent in June to 93,295 tonnes against 85,110 tonnes in June 1996.
In its Schipholland publication, the airport said May had seen an even larger increase when cargo volumes rose to 97,334 tonnes from 86,585 tonnes a year earlier for a rise of 12.4 percent.
The number of flights increased in both months by around eight percent. In June, flights increased by 8.1 percent to 29,550.

Passenger numbers also rose in June to 2.78 million up 12.7 percent on the same month last year and more than the airport handled in August last year, the busiest month of 1996. - Reuters Air Cargo Service Tel+ 44 171 542 7706 Fax +5017 - www.racs.com
